description: Search the Prickelly catalog for products on Amazon.com.tr, Hepsiburada or Trendyol. Returns the current price, marketplace, shop URL and Prickelly history link. No sign-in required.

lang.description: Output language: "en" or "tr". Defaults to the user's language when the client says it, otherwise English.

marketplace.description: Optional marketplace: amazon_tr, hepsiburada, or trendyol.

query.description: Search text, for example a product name or brand.

name: search_products
title: Search products
